title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Tropical Mango Banana 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Mango Banana from the Doozy Seriously Tropical Shortfill collection combines the rich, vibrant, tropical taste of ripe mangoes with the smooth, creamy mellow sweetness of bananas. This e-liquid delivers a balanced and satisfying fruit flavour that’s perfect for vapers who enjoy a sweet and smooth vape experience. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle ensures your favourite e-liquid goes the distance, with 20ml of free space for the addition of nicotine shots to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits, mods, and sub-ohm tanks. Doozy Vape Co., based in the UK, are renowned for creating high-quality e-liquids in a staggering variety of exciting flavour profiles you won’t find anywhere else. Their Seriously Tropical collection brings together some of the most vibrant and tropical exotic fruit blends for a sweet, satisfying and sunny vaping experience. Discover the rest of the Seriously Tropical range at Vapestore and find your new favourite flavour today.
